scope: Read only the original frames.rs/mutation.rs and their index/main context. No old/frozen source, proof, cap or runtime profile edited; no test or expensive certificate construction performed by this initial review.
argument: Input::next already verifies original full frame digest over fixed domain, all50 header bytes and the exact stored payload, following sequence/backlink/kind/codec/size/budget checks; terminal additionally enforces EOF before returning the frame.

Represent original verified digest as a private Option or enum variant constructible only by this successful admission path. Frame header/payload/digest must be private with no mutable accessors. Newly encoded from_decoded/end frames carry no authenticated original digest even if provisional headers happen to match.

Output::emit preserves every existing allowance check, then constructs the exact emitted header by rewriting sequence and predecessor. Reusing the admitted digest is valid exactly when the entire emitted50-byte header equals the authenticated original header and payload has remained immutable.

When header differs or the frame was newly encoded, hash the same fixed frame domain and exact emitted header/payload. Feed the selected/computed digest to output and subsequent chain exactly as before. A changed context or earlier mutation forces suffix predecessor comparison to fail under the same digest-collision assumption already used by the format.

Reuse removes only redundant calculation of a value already authenticated from identical bytes. It does not skip original-frame validation, decode checks where originally invoked, source totals, tail/patch validation, EOF, storage limits or independent native verification. No speedup amount or whole workload completion follows from source review alone.
required_regressions: Untouched compressed and uncompressed frames plus terminal reproduce exact original bytes and pass production Reader; prove that emission reused authenticated digests rather than secretly recomputing, using test-only per-thread digest-call counters or equivalent private instrumentation.
Rebound context produces bytes identical to an always-recompute reference, passes Reader under new context, and recomputes every affected header (first frame and suffix).

Insert/drop/reorder/duplicate frames and mutate a payload after an unchanged prefix: compare exact serialized bytes to the old always-recompute implementation; changed frame and every changed-backlink suffix rehash; untouched prefix reuses.

New Frame::from_decoded with zero context/first sequence deliberately makes its provisional header equal the final emitted header: it must still recompute and verify. Frame::end must similarly have no trusted zero digest.

Corrupt claimed digest and encoded payload independently while leaving header/order unchanged: Input::next rejects before an eligible original frame can be emitted. Preserve existing wrong chain/sequence, terminal/trailing input and cap rejection coverage.

Any replacement for mutation.rs direct header/digest accesses preserves exact malformed output, especially terminal truncate-last-byte, and preserves the intentional invalid framing behavior of drop/swap/omit/trailing modes.

Run old/new helpers on the same bounded real/synthetic accepted fixture, same index/result/context arguments for every supported mutation mode and all existing binding constructors; compare complete output bytes/sidecars and command outcomes. Keep original verifier semantic rejection expectations exact, without broadening to transport errors.

If measuring speed, use an explicitly bounded identical-source prefix/fixture and both helper identities; count skipped redundant hashes separately from wall time. Final same1800s full construction outcome is separate actual evidence, not inferred from a microbenchmark.

storage_review.c1_prefix: An actual entire byte-for-byte [0,n) equality check against an authenticated retained original proof, with separately recorded hashes and stable closed no-follow single-link inode/size/timestamps, can establish the failed temporary contains no unique bytes. Samples alone are insufficient. Keep all failed logs/receipts and deterministic reconstruction recipe requiring exact original whole identity before extracting n bytes. Require two exact owner quiescence observations and a durable before/after unlink transition. No deletion is authorized by this conceptual review.
storage_review.c2_complete_mutant: A new fresh negative verifier may consume the existing complete mutant only after full byte identity and exact successful construction/recipe/positive-source eligibility admission. Original interrupted verification remains interrupted; it contributes no successful rejection result.
storage_review.caps: No cap increase, original positive certificate deletion, shared-prefix source mutation or failed v3 suite status conversion.
